title: Cancel has to be real.
hook: Most cancellation is decoration. Ours is a state machine.
thesis: In Orca, cancellation is a real, typed behavior: TIMEOUT_REQUESTED, WORKER_TERMINATED, EFFECT_STATUS_UNKNOWN. Not a flag that says cancel and hopes for the best, but named states the system tracks and reconciles. A short, technical, satisfying post for engineers who have fought fake cancellation in other frameworks.

verified: Cancellation is real and typed: TIMEOUT_REQUESTED, WORKER_TERMINATED, EFFECT_STATUS_UNKNOWN (orca-omniroute-audit; MEMORY.md continuous-execution directive, via SYSTEMS.md section 4).

approval_gate: Nolan approves every exact post. Silence is not approval.
